title: Scary MallWorld?
content: I posted this on an older thread but wanted to post again to see what others had to say. Like the other dreamers, I have had these dreams for years, however, with the added detail that I had these dreams as a child, then they subsided for some time during my teens, then came back as a young adult. Additionally, it seems that other’s dreams are more pleasant or ominous whereas my own are usually very tense and anxiety-ridden. My mall/airport/school also floats but I usually can’t see any outside surroundings, if I do, they are similar to what was described as “end of times” or universe being ripped apart. What others have compared to as Los Vegas, I have come to believe is Orlando, Florida. The hotel is very cheap and liminal, with outside access to the rooms. You can get to these rooms using an elevator. From the hotel, I typically go to an amusement/water park where every ride has really tall stairs that you need to climb to access the ride. From the park, I usually enter a cinema/theatre which is always very empty and dark. I never watch the full movie and there’s always some disturbance preventing the movie from showing. From the movies, I will enter a mall that is somewhat brighter and more populated. A personal element that I think had entered these dreams is the element of prom dress shopping with girls in my class (I’ve always struggled with body image and I can never find a dress that I like in the dream). Another store I can vividly remember resembles a Hot Topic, and another is full of trinkets as mentioned by another poster. Sometimes the mall can be access using an escalator in the airport’s foodcourt. These escalators always freak me out as they’re so numerous and are placed near a floor-to-ceiling window that exposes the floating nature of the building. Other aspects that are common in these dreams are being chased, being late for an event, as well as making some gut wrenching travels in shotty planes. My only experience with the beautiful land that some described as being below the floating mall, would be sometimes when I find myself walking with a group in a beautiful green field on a path that leads us between two towering mountains.
